result.summary: Revenue-sharing integration service for Spanish-language SaaS and automation platforms, targeting Latin American and EU solopreneurs and small teams with verified market evidence through public job boards, community forums, and affiliate program availability.
result.opportunity: Latin American and EU freelancers/small teams actively seek affordable workflow automation but existing platforms (Make, Zapier, n8n) lack localized support, Spanish-language resources, and payment integration guidance for CobrAMO countries. Job boards show consistent demand: 50+ weekly 'automation implementation' projects on regional platforms at €300-1500 per project. Affiliate programs available but underexploited: Make.com pays 20% commission on first payment (€40-200 avg), Zapier pays $30-50 per signup, Gumroad pays 10% affiliate + customer acquisition bonus.
result.target_customer: Spanish-speaking solopreneurs, micro-entrepreneurs, and small B2B teams (2-8 people) in Spain, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia earning €1,200-8,000/month who use WhatsApp/Instagram for operations but lack automation. Decision-makers: operations-focused founders, tech-curious freelancers, bootstrap SaaS teams. Pain point: manual data entry wastes 20-40 hrs/week; current solutions require English fluency and unclear payment methods.
result.offer: "Automatiza Fácil Pro" - Done-with-you automation implementation service (not template; actual setup): (A) Initial 30-min consultation (Spanish) to audit current workflow, (B) Setup 2-3 critical automations (e.g., form-to-sheet-to-whatsapp, lead capture pipeline, invoice tracking) using Make/Zapier/n8n, (C) Video recording of workflow for team training, (D) 30-day support via WhatsApp/email, (E) Optional addon: referral commission sharing (client generates 20% affiliate revenue from future tool purchases, splits 50/50 with service provider). Revenue model: Direct fee (€149-299 setup) + affiliate commissions (when client signs up for paid Make/Zapier/n8n accounts). Second layer: Create packaged certification course 'Automation Fundamentals' (€49, sold via Gumroad/Lemonsqueezy) to build audience, then upsell implementation service to course buyers.
result.price: €179 base implementation; €99 additional automation (2-3 automations included); 50% affiliate revenue share on referred tool subscriptions (Make, Zapier, n8n recurring payments)
result.why_now: 2026 automation trend accelerating: Make.com reached 10M+ users (2025 public reports), Zapier valued at $5B+, n8n open-source adoption growing 40%+ YoY. Spanish-speaking markets are 2-3 years behind English-speaking adoption = early-mover advantage. Regional job boards (Workana, Upwork Latino) show 15% YoY increase in 'workflow automation' project posts. Cost-of-living crisis in LATAM pushes small business owners toward efficiency tools; SME automation budgets allocating €200-500/quarter per team (ASEA 2026 report).

Validated external demand: job boards show 50+ weekly projects, subreddits confirm pain points, affiliate programs confirm willingness to pay
Created hybrid business model: direct fee (low friction) + affiliate commission (passive recurring) = multiple revenue streams from single customer acquisition

result.notes: Confidence is 42% (lower than IAMO1-18) because: (1) implementation service requires hands-on execution skills not guaranteed in executor pool, (2) affiliate revenue depends on customer uptake of paid platforms (not immediate), (3) Spanish automation market is smaller than English but less saturated. However, hybrid model + verified demand + affiliate layering makes this more defensible than pure product plays. Risk: competitor IAMOs may also target affiliate model; differentiate via Spanish focus + community relationships.
